notes.title: Steam Deck Compatible!
notes.notes:
I was able to grab a Steam Deck during this last Steam sale. Moon Raider, as expected, runs really well on the Steam Deck. It is also on Switch, but that version is published by a different company. This version I control, which means it has the control map I'd intended for players to use. It also runs at twice the frame rate as the console ports. It is, in my opinion, the best version of the game.

Unfortunately, I'm not yet invited to the Deck Verified program. As soon as that is available to me, I will submit the game.

notes.title: Guts 'n Grunts
notes.notes:
I am excited to share that our latest game, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2266600/Guts_n_Grunts/]Guts 'n Grunts[/url], is now available on Steam! Much like Moon Raider, this game is a polished platformer that keeps you interested from start to finish.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37982694/c0b3255f4868a983f32506eadafab0652aae49e7.gif[/img]

Guts 'n Grunts features clean, 16-bit graphics with big enemies and even bigger bosses. It has 8-way shooting like Contra. And it has tubes that quickly roll you from one place to another, often shooting you out like a spinning blade. There are 72 mini missions, hidden powers-ups, and ability upgrades.

It's [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2266600/Guts_n_Grunts/]out now[/url] with a 15% launch discount.
